constraints: Server refuses local_trusted on a nonloopback bind.
A Linux host-network container allows localhost-only host access. Remote UI can use an SSH tunnel.
No Authorization or Origin is needed for localhost API; implicit Local Board has instance administrator privileges.
Use authenticated mode with a stable BETTER_AUTH_SECRET for shared network access; the bundle does not silently turn local_trusted into a LAN service.
local_trusted.auth_bootstrap: BetterAuth is not instantiated in local_trusted; the local board principal is initialized by the server.

bootstrap_order: Start pinned PostgreSQL and Paperclip runtime with persistent data and explicit loopback bind.
List existing companies with GET /api/companies and reuse the intended company id, or create once. Persist returned ids; do not use names as globally unique identities.
Register compiled offline OMP adapter by absolute container-visible local path.
Create/reuse projects using container-visible workspace paths.
Create agents with explicit runner legacy and inert heartbeat settings.
Review adapter config/provisioned provider model identity and run environment tests before activation.
Activate only the chosen agents and execute the disposable acceptance tasks before importing real work.

notes: Paths and model IDs in examples are templates and must match mounted artifacts and configured internal model provider.
Company requireBoardApprovalForNewAgents defaults false in this release; if an existing company enables it, direct agent creation409 requires its approval flow, not silent governance changes.
OMP installation requires the compiled dist tree and bundled production node_modules accessible to Paperclip. isLocalPath:true skips npm.
Agent configuration supports runner auto, paperclip, legacy. The legacy CLI route is deliberate here; it does not claim native Runner child-worker introspection.
Heartbeat defaults are intentionally inert until provider and sandbox acceptance checks pass; wakeOnDemand is the non-timer execution gate.

body.title: Disposable offline acceptance task
body.description: Use the provisioned internal model and disposable workspace; write evidence to the task.

activate_on_demand.note: Fetch existing runtimeConfig first and merge heartbeat into it to preserve unrelated existing config. Timer remains off; assignments/manual wake can now execute. Creating/assigning a todo issue can trigger execution, so do this only after qualification.

invoke.note: Legacy supported empty-body manual invocation, still subject to wakeOnDemand gate and status/governance. Prefer task-scoped work; manual wake can consume model capacity.

pause.note: Board operation pauses the agent and requests cancellation of active runs; verify terminal run states before reusing any worktree.

resume.note: Resumes eligible agent; invalid org reporting chain remains409.

notes: enabled and intervalSec govern timer scheduling; setting enabled:false alone does not disable assignment/manual/non-timer wakeups.
wakeOnDemand:false gates non-timer wakes as well as automatic assignment wakeups.
maxConcurrentRuns is per agent, not a global host/inference concurrency limit.
Dollars reported as zero for internal inference do not constrain GPU capacity; enforce model gateway and host resource concurrency separately.
Place actual models.yml at /paperclip/agentic-config/omp/models.yml. modelsYaml is inline YAML text, not a filename; omit it when using the mounted directory.
Avoid setting profile when using agentDir: a profile takes precedence. Clear inherited OMP_PROFILE/PI_PROFILE or provision an explicit matching profile.
Set PAPERCLIP_OMP_OFFLINE_MODELS on the server so adapter startup/summary/picker all use the static local catalog.
The downstream 0.7.0-offline.1 adapter disables model discovery and quota probes unless an operator explicitly opts back in; do not enable those opt-ins in the offline environment.
Model API keys referenced by name must actually exist. OMP can treat an unresolved bare key name as a literal, so fail closed in the launcher when an authenticated gateway key is absent.
The root-provided runner wrapper should reference the provisioned binary. Do not auto-install a missing runtime from npm.
